digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend, comment sanitization
propositions: rebar hardcodes comment ceiling to 32767 chars while Jira Data Center admin can raise or disable (set to 0) the jira.text.field.character.limit property, causing silent truncation of valid comments when the instance limit exceeds the hardcoded value

comments longer than 32767 but shorter than an admin-raised ceiling are silently truncated, resulting in permanent divergence between local and remote bodies without operator awareness beyond a truncation warning

comment sanitization shares the description fitter which uses different logic (ADF-size based on Cloud), creating a structural trap where changes to description fitting could incorrectly retarget comment truncation
the DC comment ceiling must be configurable via configuration with default 32767 matching jira.text.field.character.limit default, and zero must mean unlimited
send-side sanitize_comment and differ-side fit_comment must converge on identical truncation behavior using the same configured ceiling, not different fitlers or constants
